newsitem.title: USA: High Point, N.C., approves $68 million GO bonds.
newsitem.headline: High Point, N.C., approves $68 million GO bonds.

text.p: Voters in High Point, N.C., approved at least five general obligation bond issues totalling $68 million, elections officials said Wednesday.
Voters rejected a $550,000 GO issue for an indoor swimming pool in Tueday's balloting.

Results of a seventh GO bond proposal, $3 million for parks and recreation, had not been determined Wednesday. Elections officials said only two votes separated the "yes" and "no" totals, so the final results would not be known until absentee ballots are counted the results audited.
The bond referendum package was the largest in city history.
The five issues that were approved totalled $68 million. They were:
--$35 million for upgrades at the Eastside WaterTreatment Plant.
--$10 million for High Point's share of the Randleman Dam project on the Deep River.
--$12 million for street widening and resurfacing projects.
